content: libass hardsub on Android: subtitles filter supports fontsdir option pointing to a directory of TTF/OTF - on Android fontconfig is absent so fontsdir (internal font provider) is the reliable path; fontname in .ass Style must be the family name WITHOUT extension; libass <0.17.2 had font-selection bugs - use recent libass (ffmpeg-kit bundles a recent one). FFmpegKit also offers FFmpegKitConfig.setFontDirectoryList. Path escaping in filtergraph is a classic failure (colons, quotes, spaces).
